name: Rachel Bennett
summary: Working mother balancing a full-time job, two school-age kids, and a tight household budget. Pragmatic and time-poor. Comfortable with mainstream apps but has no patience for clutter or long onboarding. Abandons flows that ask for too much up front.

name: Daniel Okafor
summary: Early-career developer, highly technical, skims UI and pokes at edge cases. Expects fast, terse interactions and gets annoyed by hand-holding or forced tutorials. Will try to break things and notices inconsistent states.

name: Margaret Hollis
summary: Retired, not very technical, uses a tablet with large text. Reads instructions carefully but is easily confused by unlabeled icons, small tap targets, and jargon. Values reassurance and clear next steps. Gives up quietly rather than complaining.

name: Priya Nair
summary: Runs a small retail shop, uses her phone for everything, multitasks constantly. Price sensitive and skeptical of subscriptions. Wants immediate, concrete value and proof before committing time or money.

name: Lucas Meyer
summary: Digital native, fast and impatient, judges apps in seconds on vibe and speed. Expects social/sharing features and dark mode. Will churn instantly if the app feels dated or slow, but evangelizes things he loves.

name: Aisha Rahman
summary: Shift worker with irregular hours, uses apps in short bursts. Cares about privacy and data handling. Reads permission prompts. Prefers apps that respect her time and let her pick up where she left off.

name: Tom Whitfield
summary: Practical, blue-collar, uses a rugged phone with a cracked screen outdoors. Big fingers, bright sunlight, spotty connectivity. Hates tiny text and forms. Wants the app to just work offline-ish and get to the point.

name: Sofia Alvarez
summary: Design-conscious, notices spacing, typography, and micro-interactions immediately. Bilingual, sometimes uses the app in Spanish. Forgiving of bugs if the aesthetic and flow feel considered, harsh if it looks unpolished.
